280702292.description:
Assorted Rock and Mineral Specimens Educational Collection 3.1 lbs Labeled Set
This collection includes assorted rock and mineral specimens with various types, colors, and textures. Each specimen is labeled with a number or letter for identification purposes, including labels such as 7, 2, 5, 12, I, and P. Notable pieces include a glossy black glass-like stone resembling obsidian, along with several gray and brown rocky minerals. All specimens are individually packaged in clear plastic bags. The total weight of the collection is approximately 3.1 pounds as measured on an Accuteck digital scale. The items are in used condition with visible signs of prior handling but remain stable. Suitable for geology study, earth sciences education, or rock collecting.
